name.value: Canadas Best Value Desert Inn & Suites

description.value: A modern two-story motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Cache Creek, operated under the Canada's Best Value Inn brand by Sonesta. Cache Creek sits at a historic crossroads in the Thompson-Okanagan interior, long used as a resupply point for travellers heading north, and the motel continues that tradition as a practical stop for long-distance road users. The property is pet-friendly, offers guest laundry, and advertises truck and bus parking, signalling familiarity with travellers arriving with large or heavy loads.
